label: Permission set
description: Grants roles access: per entity (create, read and update scopes none/related/all, delete, optional ABAC update condition), per field (hidden, read, write), and platform actions (config.edit, audit.read, records.export, ...). Access is denied by default and grants from several sets combine.
usage: Create one permission set per role and keep it readable: entity grants first, then field exceptions.
Use read: related for requesters so they only see records they are named on.
Grant audit.read and records.export only to roles that need them.
constraints: read and update are none, related, or all; related uses the entity's accessFields.
Field access is hidden, read, or write; field "*" covers all fields and a specific field entry overrides it within the set.
Across sets grants combine as a union (most permissive wins); hidden fields are never sent to the client.
actions must be platform actions; updateCondition is a CEL-subset expression over record and user.
